FN-GG45C6C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 401
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/10/2024
REVISED
House Bill 401 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Public Education Employees'
Health Insurance Board and State Employees' Insurance Board by an estimated $4.5 million and
$3.6 million annually, respectively, due to the minimum rate set for health insurers to pay
out-of-network ground ambulance providers in this bill.
Page 1
